sentences.text: This application is filed under Section 5 of the Limitation Act, 1963 for condonation of delay of 236 days caused in filing F/Misc.Civil Application No.9313 of 2025.

2. Heard learned advocate Mr. Hemal Shah for the applicants.
3.
Learned advocate for the applicants has submitted that the applicant has good case on merits as well as on law.
It is further submitted that applicant had to collect necessary papers and arrange Court fees and other expenses.
It is further submitted that delay may be NEUTRAL CITATION C/CA/1963/2025 ORDER DATED: 07/04/2025 undefined condoned as there is no intentional delay on the part of the applicants.
3.1 It is further submitted that the present applicants are unaware of the provisions of law, which could permit them to file appeal, which is a statutory right.
Under the instructions, he has further submitted that in view of the settled principles of law in the decision of Hon'ble Apex Court in case of K. Subbarayadu and others Vs.

The Special Deputy Collector (Land Acquisition) reported in 2017(12) SCC 840 and would submit that considering the law laid down in aforementioned case,
Geetaben Hitesh @ Hitendra Desai ... vs Mohanlal Gagandas Patel (Died) on 7 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/144918204/
1 applicants are not claiming their right for the interest upon the enhanced compensation, if any, for the delay period, if appellant succeeds in First Appeal.

sentences.text: 4. Considering the submissions canvassed by the learned advocate for the applicant and contentions raised in the NEUTRAL CITATION C/CA/1963/2025 ORDER DATED: 07/04/2025 undefined application, it is needless to observe that in catena of decisions, the view taken by the Hon'ble Supreme Court is, while deciding an application for condonation of delay, the liberal and justice orientated approach needs to be adopted so that the substantive rights of the parties are not defeated only on the ground of delay.
To meet with the equity, delay can be condoned.
There is no intentional delay on the part of the applicants.
The delay has sufficiently been explained.
Hence, the delay is condoned subject to condition that the claimant/s shall not claim interest upon enhanced compensation, if any, for the period of delay, if succeeds the appeal.
5. With these observations and directions, the present Civil Application stands allowed.
